name: network-engineer
description: Network Engineer for Solaris - designs and runs the owner's own multi-system, multi-machine network across the dev shop and game studio. Covers home/office network topology (gateway/switch/AP roles, IP planning, DHCP/DNS), VLAN segmentation and trust zones, WireGuard VPN remote access, Pi-hole / local DNS filtering, self-hosted cluster bring-up (Uncloud + Caddy + WireGuard mesh), and enterprise networking ops (Cisco IOS/IOS-XE review, Netmiko SSH automation, BGP diagnostics, interface health, config validation). Read-only-first and change-window discipline throughout. Use when Shai says network, homelab, VLAN, subnet, segmentation, trust zone, IoT isolation, gateway, router, switch, trunk, access port, DHCP, DNS, Pi-hole, AdGuard, Unbound, home.arpa, WireGuard, VPN, split tunnel, full tunnel, DDNS, port forward, self-host cluster, Uncloud, Caddy, reverse proxy, Cisco, IOS, ACL, wildcard mask, Netmiko, BGP, peering, interface errors, CRC, duplex mismatch, or config validation.
author: Shai Ali
absorbed_from: affaan-m/everything-claude-code (ECC, MIT) - methodology only, no code bundled. Absorbed 2026-06-14 from skills/ tree @ HEAD:

ECC skills/homelab-network-setup (2026-06-14): gateway/switch/AP role separation, IP plan conventions (.1 gateway, .2-.49 infra, .50-.240 DHCP), home.arpa local names, DHCP reservations for service hosts, wired AP backhaul, double-NAT and 192.168.1.0/24 anti-patterns.

ECC skills/homelab-vlan-segmentation (2026-06-14): 5-zone VLAN template (trusted/IoT/servers/guest/management), SSID-to-VLAN mapping, trunk vs access port behavior, default-deny inter-VLAN rules, Pi-hole in Servers VLAN with port-53 allow-before-block ordering, native-VLAN-not-equal-management anti-pattern (VLAN hopping).

ECC skills/homelab-wireguard-vpn (2026-06-14): keypair-per-device, split vs full vs multi-subnet tunnel, PersistentKeepalive=25 for mobile, scoped iptables forwarding (not blanket FORWARD ACCEPT), DDNS with credentials in 600-mode env files, keys never in version control, troubleshooting via wg show / handshake / ip_forward.

ECC skills/homelab-pihole-dns (2026-06-14): pinned-tag Docker deploy (never latest for DNS infra), static IP before install, router-DHCP DNS pointing, blocklist/gravity management, DoH via cloudflared local proxy, local DNS records (home.arpa over .local/.lan), redundancy via second Pi-hole not public fallback for strict blocking.

ECC skills/homelab-network-readiness (2026-06-14): planning/review-first checklist before any router/firewall/DHCP/VPN change - required inventory table, trust-zone default policies, DNS-as-dependency-not-SPOF, remote-access readiness, small-reversible change sequence, lockout-prevention (out-of-band/console access), rollback in platform vocabulary.

ECC skills/uncloud (2026-06-14): self-hosted cluster bring-up with uc CLI - WireGuard-mesh peer model (no central control plane), Caddy global ingress with auto-TLS, x-ports / x-caddy / x-machines compose extensions, autogenerated-Caddyfile rule (never edit directly), routing external LAN devices via pause-container + --caddyfile, internal service DNS, zero-downtime health-gated deploys.

ECC skills/network-config-validation (2026-06-14): layered pre-deploy config review (dangerous commands -> credential/mgmt-plane -> duplicate IP / subnet overlap -> stale ACL/route-map/prefix-list refs -> operational hygiene), regex-as-warning-not-parser, VTY block section parsing, SNMPv3-over-v2, enable-secret-over-password, fail-closed automation gate.

ECC skills/cisco-ios-patterns (2026-06-14): IOS/IOS-XE review workflow (capture state -> review candidate -> confirm no lockout -> smallest change in window -> re-read -> save only after validation), read-only show-command menu, wildcard-mask-vs-subnet-mask discipline, ACL placement/direction review, interface hygiene, running vs startup config.

ECC skills/netmiko-ssh-automation (2026-06-14): read-only-first Python SSH automation - send_command default, getpass/env-var creds (never hardcoded), conn/auth/read timeouts, bounded ThreadPoolExecutor concurrency, per-device failure isolation, TextFSM parse-as-optimization-keep-raw, guarded send_config_set behind APPLY flag, save_config as separate approval step.

ECC skills/network-bgp-diagnostics (2026-06-14): diagnostics-only BGP triage - identify neighbor/AFI/SAFI/VRF/ASN first, summary + last-reset-reason, state interpretation table (Idle/Connect/Active/OpenSent/Established), transport vs policy split, advertised/received/installed route compare, AS-path regex token boundaries, change-window-only resets (prefer soft/route-refresh).

ECC skills/network-interface-health (2026-06-14): counter-trend-over-absolute diagnosis - baseline then re-measure increments, counter reference table (CRC/runts/giants/input-drops/output-drops/resets), check both ends of a link, auto-neg vs fixed duplex discipline, congestion-before-cable for output drops, clear counters only after baseline.

Hosting Cleanup gig depth 2026-06-20 (methodology, license-safe, no copy-paste): NET-NEW server-hardening-tls-headers.md - the host/server side of a hosting cleanup. (1) TLS posture scan via testssl.sh (GPLv2 - flag: invoke, do not vendor) with a 2026 baseline (TLS1.2/1.3 only, no weak ciphers, FS, OCSP stapling, HSTS-after-HTTPS ordering rule) - read-only first, change-window-only for live edits, re-scan after. (2) Edge security-header baseline (HSTS/CSP-report-first/nosniff/Referrer-Policy/Permissions-Policy/frame-ancestors; strip version banners) at NGINX/Apache/LiteSpeed/Caddy, composing with the existing Caddy/Uncloud ingress. (3) CIS-benchmark host hardening (Level 1 first then selective Level 2; SSH/firewall/web-server/account-log baselines; assess read-only then remediate smallest-first in-window; CIS-CAT Pro membership-gated -> recommend OpenSCAP/Lynis OSS for the scan). Carries the read-only-first + change-window + lockout-prevention + rollback-in-platform-vocabulary doctrine throughout. License flags: testssl GPLv2; CIS-CAT Pro gated (OSS alternatives noted).
